# Copilot Instructions

**The rules for this repository live in [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md). Read that file
before writing code, and follow it exactly.**

This file deliberately contains no rules of its own. A second copy of
`CLAUDE.md` kept in sync by hand drifts; one copy cannot.

If the user corrects your code with a general rule that is not yet written down,
add it to [docs/CODING-STANDARDS.md](../docs/CODING-STANDARDS.md) — never here.

## Reading order

1. [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) — the rules.
2. [docs/CODING-STANDARDS.md](../docs/CODING-STANDARDS.md) — how code is written.
3. The routing table in `CLAUDE.md` points to the rest of
   [docs/](../docs/) for whatever the task needs.

**The product is not fully specified.** If a task needs a decision that is not
written down, add it to
[docs/product/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md](../docs/product/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md) and ask — do
not invent product behaviour.
